The '''''Chelandion''''' was a class of 800 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]&ndash;long [[Warship/Legends|warships]] developed for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] that were used during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The Chelandion was covered in bright [[chrome]] and armed with powerful [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. It also had a large load of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].

The design was considered to have lighter [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] than most [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], but very strong [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. They were also equipped with a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]] to prevent any from falling into enemy hands.

==History==
They were used by Hutt forces during the [[Second Battle of Balmorra]] and the [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]].
